title: Stickman Three Kingdoms
description: Clash across lively stickman battlefields starring iconic Three Kingdoms warriors—unleash sweeping spear combos and rally legions to conquer China.
controls: Use directional and attack/skill buttons to slash through rival stickman squads and command troops.

zh-CN.title: 火柴人三国
zh-CN.description: 魔性横版动作火柴人三国：简约带感的火柴人武将化身三国名将，大招连放率领大军冲锋陷阵爽感十足！
zh-CN.controls: 点击左右移动与攻击技能按钮操作火柴人武将冲锋斩敌，带领军团推平敌阵。
